title: Underwriting Basis for the Corrected Declaration on a Travel Protection Certificate
content:
Where the underwriting desk has approved a correction of the trip cost declared on a certificate of the
Travel Protection Plans, the declared trip cost is corrected to the prepaid cost of the journey the records
show, and never above the plan's ceiling on the declared trip cost.

## The prepaid cost of the journey

The prepaid cost of the journey is what the traveller has laid out on the holiday the cover was bought alongside,
less what has been returned to them and less anything settled other than in money, taken in the share of the
party the certificate covers, together with what has been prepaid for flights bought apart from it.

| Quantity | What it is |
|---|---|
| The cost of the holiday | The price the package was quoted at |
| What counts as prepaid | The whole of that cost, except the charges raised for optional components |
| What has been returned | Nothing |
| What was settled other than in money | Nothing, no credit having been settled against the holiday |
| The share of the party the certificate covers | The whole of that cost |
| What has been prepaid for flights bought apart | Nothing |

The three deductions are taken together before the share is applied, and the figure at that point is never less
than nothing; the share is then applied to it, and what has been prepaid for flights bought apart is added
afterwards, outside the share. The corrected figure is rounded to two decimal places once, at the end, and no
intermediate figure is rounded.

## Worked through on hypothetical figures

A holiday was quoted at 12400.00, of which 900.00 was raised for optional components; what counts as prepaid is
therefore 11500.00. Nothing has been returned and nothing was settled other than in money, so the figure stands
at 11500.00. The whole of that cost is counted for the certificate, and nothing is added for flights bought
apart, so the prepaid cost of the journey is 11500.00. Where the plan's ceiling on the declared trip cost is
20000, the declared trip cost is corrected to 11500.00; where the plan's ceiling is 10000, it is corrected to
10000.00, the corrected figure never standing above the ceiling. The figures in both readings are
hypothetical.
